Middle East Flight Disruptions Cause Airline Cancellations

Etihad Airways has cancelled flights to Riyadh, Dammam, and Jeddah due to 'regional disruption'. Emirates and flydubai have also cancelled flights on Saudi routes. The cancellations are attributed to ongoing regional instability.
